---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with installation, device input, or the Onshape bridge
---

## What happened

Describe what you expected, what happened, and the steps to reproduce it.

## Your setup

- Akita SpaceMouse release (`spacemouse --version`)
- Linux distribution and version
- 3Dconnexion device model and connection type (USB cable, receiver, or Bluetooth)
- Browser and version, if applicable

## Device check

Paste the relevant output from `spacemouse doctor`. If possible, say whether `spacemouse test` showed motion or button events. Remove private details from any logs you share.
